mapper.select: SELECT radar_id as radarId, student_id as studentId, english, japanese, internship, communication, personality, professional, total_score as totalScore, create_time as createTime FROM radar_evaluation WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE radar_evaluation SET english = #{english}, japanese = #{japanese}, internship = #{internship}, communication = #{communication}, personality = #{personality}, professional = #{professional}, total_score = #{totalScore} WHERE radar_id = #{radarId}
